## Summary
Satyam Kumar Chaudhary, also known as Satyam Kumar, Satyam Chaudhary, and
codersatyam, is a full-stack developer and DevOps engineer based in Chennai,
Tamil Nadu, India. He builds production-ready web applications, APIs, DevOps
pipelines, and cloud deployments.
